info.title: Relay API
info.description:
Implemented self-hosted Relay HTTP API. Canonical contract: docs/openapi.json, served at /api/openapi. All paths below are relative to /api/v1.

Authentication uses Better Auth session cookies (/api/auth/*) or opaque native Bearer tokens from the device flow. Better Auth endpoints are outside this document; account passwords require at least 12 characters, email verification is required, and public signup depends on ALLOW_SIGNUP. Resource UUIDs are distinct from arbitrary string user IDs. Timestamps are ISO8601; media offsets are seconds.

Cookie/non-Bearer mutations require Origin equal to BETTER_AUTH_URL, including anonymous share unlocks and playback events. Device start/exchange are exempt. GET/HEAD/OPTIONS are exempt. Public share access is conditional on visibility, a valid token, and password unlock or signed-in email/workspace membership as applicable. A share token alone never grants editor permissions.

JSON errors are {error:string,code?:string}; binary range errors416 have an empty body. JSON bodies default to 1,000,000 bytes maximum unless documented otherwise. API JSON responses use Cache-Control:no-store. No cloud AI call occurs without explicitly configured provider credentials; /admin/ai/test itself makes a real provider call.

post.description: Signed-in email must be verified and match the invitation. Invite must be unexpired and unused. Response workspace contains id/name.

post.description: Any workspace member may create a folder. Parent, when supplied, must belong to the same workspace.

patch.description: Any member of the containing workspace.

delete.description: Workspace owner/admin only. Recordings and child folders remain; their deleted folder reference becomes null.

get.description: Requires membership. Newest first, capped at 200; no pagination. Owner/admin can list all videos in workspace. Ordinary members see their own videos, workspace visibility, and videos explicitly shared with their verified email. Unlisted links alone do not add a video to this list.

parameters.description: Search title, description, and published transcript. Only the first 200 characters are used.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Supported values: all, favorites, watch-later, archived. Other strings currently behave as all. Archived videos appear only for archived.

get.summary: Read video detail and published-revision conversation
get.description: Video owner or workspace owner/admin can edit. Workspace visibility requires membership; unlisted requires valid token; password requires token plus unlock cookie; shared requires a signed-in verified allowed email. Private is editor-only.

patch.description: Requires sign-in and video access. Title/description/folder/archive changes require edit permission; favorite/watchLater only change current user bookmarks.

delete.description: Editor only. Immediately hides video, revokes shares, and fails pending jobs. Queues media cleanup after seven days; does not remove a native local file.

post.summary: Create or resume recording with stable client UUID
post.description: Requires workspace membership. Reusing the same owner/clientId returns the prior upload state without creating another recording. Canceled/deleted IDs or changed workspaces conflict. Use returned video.initialRevisionId for incoming on-device transcript. Admitted uploads resume even if speech configuration was later revoked. New admission with an unavailable speech selection returns 409 SPEECH_CONFIGURATION_UNAVAILABLE; clients may explicitly reselect without discarding clientId. An admitted selection is immutable.

get.description: Recording owner only, with current workspace membership.

delete.description: Recording owner only. Rejects status ready; marks other incomplete states canceled and fails queued/running jobs. Does not delete local media.

put.summary: Upload one SHA-256 verified media part
put.description: Recording owner only. 1–8388608 raw bytes. Repeating an acknowledged part with identical bytes/hash/size is idempotent. Different bytes at the same index conflict; no new parts may be added after finalization.

post.summary: Verify contiguous manifest and queue media processing
post.description: Recording owner only. Existing part records and on-disk sizes must match. An identical finalized manifest remains idempotent even after processing. Different finalized manifest conflicts.

get.description: Editors only; newest first.

post.summary: Queue trimmed, stitched, blurred revision
post.description: Editor access to destination and all source videos. Originals are preserved. Successful rendering publishes only if its expected base is still current; superseded render remains an unpublished version. Cleanup provenance requires a ready analysis with the current transcript content version; stale analyses return 409. Cuts remap retained timestamped conversations and fully retained chapter ranges, including repeated clips. Foreign-video discussions and untimed top-level comments are not imported. Speech inherits retained source text and manual-correction protection. Missing source speech remains explicitly incomplete with known text preserved; rendering never inherits consent for external transcription of a composite. Untimed text is retained only for whole-source clips.

post.summary: Publish a ready version
post.description: Editor only. Revision must belong to this video and be ready.

post.summary: Set visibility and rotate share link
post.description: Editor only. Replaces password and allowed emails, rotates token, increments unlock version. Private visibility still returns settings/link but that link cannot be read publicly.

delete.summary: Revoke link and return video to private visibility
delete.description: Editor only. Removes share and email access records; previous token no longer works.

get.summary: Resolve share link to video detail
get.description: Token alone grants access only for unlisted visibility. Password links require the unlock cookie; workspace links require workspace membership; explicit-email links require sign-in with a verified allowed email. Editors retain access. Private/deleted/revoked shares return 404.

post.summary: Verify password and set short-lived unlock cookie

Set-Cookie.description: Encrypted per-video password unlock cookie; retain on subsequent media/detail requests.

post.description: Password visibility only. Sets HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie named relay_share_<videoId with hyphens removed>, valid one hour and bound to current share version. Secure flag is enabled when BETTER_AUTH_URL uses HTTPS. Link changes invalidate it. Limit:20 attempts /900 seconds per video.

post.summary: Add timestamped comment or reply
post.description: Signed-in viewer with video access; published revision required. Notifies owner and reply parent author except current author. Limit: 30 comments per user /60 seconds. Returns only new comment ID; reload detail for full record.

patch.description: Author or video editor, with current video access. Body is trimmed. Timestamp/revision/parent cannot be changed.

delete.description: Author or video editor, with current video access.

post.summary: Add idempotent personal emoji reaction
post.description: Signed-in viewer with access. Unique per video/user/emoji. Counts and current-user reacted state are returned in video detail.

delete.description: Signed-in viewer with access. Removes only current user reaction; deleting a missing reaction is successful.

get.description: Newest first, capped at 100. No pagination.

post.summary: Mark own notification read
post.description: Signed-in user. Notification belonging to another user or missing ID remains unchanged and returns success.

post.summary: Record revision-scoped viewer activity
post.description: Allows anonymous viewers only when video access permits. Non-Bearer clients must still send trusted Origin. May set encrypted HttpOnly relay_viewer cookie (30 days) for stable anonymous counts. Limit: 2000 events per viewer/video/hour.

get.description: Editors only. Legacy approximate point-event metrics retained for older clients. New clients use /engagement.
Same access as video detail. Published revision, or initial revision if not yet published.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: Ready historical revision; video-editor permission required.

put.description: Editor only. Revision must still match active revision. Corrections are used by generated captions and later edit remapping; word timings may be omitted when editing text.

post.summary: Queue explicitly selected server transcription
post.description: Editor only; requires a published ready revision. Missing selection uses private-server Parakeet. External audio transfer requires a versioned allowed configuration. Rejects active jobs, stale expectedRevisionId, and manually corrected text. Worker rechecks access, configuration, and lease before external requests. Playback is independent of speech failure.

post.summary: Queue optional cloud transcript notes
post.description: Editor only. Server owner must enable a provider, video must be published, and current transcript must be ready. Sends transcript text only. Existing user-edited fields are preserved on regeneration. Limit: 10 requests/user/hour.

patch.description: Editor only. Current revision must have AI results. Supplied content fields are marked edited and survive regeneration. expectedRevisionId is required: missing returns 428; a different published revision returns 409. It is a concurrency guard, not an edited field.

get.description: Instance admin only; workspace admin role is insufficient.

put.description: Instance admin only. Does not test the connection automatically and does not select a fallback provider/model.

post.summary: Test the saved provider with a small live request
post.description: Instance admin only. Tests saved configuration, including when enabled=false. Makes a real provider request (Reply with OK), potentially billable. Provider failure returns HTTP 200 with ok=false and sanitized message; absent configuration is 400. Limit: 5 tests/admin/minute.

get.description: Instance admin only. Newest 100 jobs; no pagination.

post.summary: Retry failed job with fresh attempts
post.description: Instance admin only. Only failed jobs; deleted/canceled videos cannot retry. Resets attempts and associated process/render status to queued.

post.summary: Create five-minute PKCE-style native login
post.description: challenge is SHA-256(verifier), base64url without padding. Global limit1000 starts/hour. No Origin header required.

post.summary: Approve native sign-in from authenticated browser
post.description: Signed-in user. Request must be unexpired, unconsumed, and not already approved. Browser mutation requires trusted Origin.

post.summary: Exchange approved one-use login for bearer token
post.description: No Origin required. 202 until approval; 200 returns token once. Wrong verifier 403; expired/consumed 410. Tokens expire after30 days. Limit: 120 polls/login/300 seconds.

delete.summary: Revoke the current native bearer session
delete.description: Requires sign-in. With a Bearer header deletes that device token. A cookie-authenticated call returns success without revoking any device token.

get.summary: Read authenticated server capabilities and current admission limits
get.description: Contains no credentials. New recordings snapshot these limits; resume using limits in the recording upload state.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Requires membership. When absent, only device/private-server Parakeet are listed. External configurations are filtered by this workspace and exact verified version.

get.summary: Read redacted speech configurations and supported models

put.summary: Create or version a speech provider configuration

post.summary: Test a saved configuration with disclosed synthetic speech
post.description: Instance admin only. Sends the bundled 3.094-second synthetic English phrase, never user media, to the selected provider. Provider charges may apply. Requires exact expectedVersion. Successful phrase recognition verifies this version; changes invalidate verification. Test is leased and limited to 5/admin/minute. Redacted provider failure returns 200 with ok:false. AssemblyAI persists its remote ID; ambiguous submission is not automatically repeated.

get.summary: Read the latest acoustic cleanup proposal for the published revision
get.description: Editor only. Suggestions can become stale after a transcript correction; applications compare revisionId and transcriptVersion before applying.

post.summary: Queue acoustic cleanup and optional contextual proposals
post.description: Editor only; 10 requests per minute. Private pinned Silero analysis protects detected speech, audible energy and transcript ranges. Balanced preset: 600 ms minimum gap, 250 ms retained, 100 ms speech padding. English fillers require word timing; null language disables them. Optional contextual suggestions explicitly send word text to the configured cloud model, require at most 10000 timed words, and never cut automatically. Provider failure preserves acoustic suggestions. Applying selected IDs uses the ordinary revision endpoint with cleanup provenance. Current revision and content version are checked again. Experimental quality; benchmark and Loom equivalence remain unverified.

get.summary: List built-in and latest workspace template versions
get.description: Workspace membership required. Built-ins and custom versions share the same strict document format.

put.summary: Create an immutable workspace template version
put.description: Owner/admin only. Updating requires id and expectedVersion. Maximum 100 custom templates per workspace. Existing drafts retain their original snapshot; old versions cannot be used for new drafts.

get.description: Editor only. At most 100 newest artifacts; drafts from historical revisions are not returned.

post.summary: Create a manual draft or queue cloud generation
post.description: Editor only. Manual drafts require no AI credentials or transcript. Generation requires a ready nonempty transcript of at most 100000 characters. Pins transcript content version, immutable template, selected model and encrypted-credential fingerprint. No tool execution or external delivery. Limits: 30 creations per user/hour; generated creations also count toward 20 generations per user/hour and 100 per workspace/hour.

patch.summary: Save a corrected draft or accept a generated proposal
patch.description: Editor and current published revision required. Stale versions return 409. Human edits during generation are preserved; output becomes a separate proposal. Exactly one of draft/acceptProposal is required; headings must match the template snapshot.

post.summary: Generate a proposal with the current selected cloud model
post.description: Editor only. One active job per artifact; different artifacts may generate concurrently. 20 generations per user/hour and 100 per workspace/hour. Retries retain the pinned provider/configuration. Access, transcript, settings and published revision are checked again before saving output. Human drafts remain usable on provider failure.

get.description: Editor/current revision only. Markdown exports the saved draft. JSON includes the artifact, immutable template, proposal and generation metadata. Does not include credentials. Cache-Control: no-store.

post.summary: Record an idempotent interval of visible playback
post.description: Same ACL as playback, including valid share-token/password cookie. Current published revision only. UUID event identity plus digest rejects changed retries; session identity binds video/revision/viewer/kind. Duplicate replay adds no time. Session summaries update in the same transaction as raw events. Limits: 2000 requests per viewer/video/hour, 100000 per video/hour, 4096 disjoint ranges per session, 24-hour session lifetime. Never blocks playback.

get.description: Editor only, including historical ready revisions of the same video. Defaults to the current revision and last 30 days. Maximum 90-day UTC range and 10000 sessions; narrow the range after 409. Each response enforces current video permissions. Download counts are unavailable; no events are fabricated from media downloads.

At most 90 days; cursor pagination by immutable object ID. Engagement uses B1 session-start dates, all measured ready revisions and current publication status. At most 10000 sessions per page. Team rows include current members with recording/playback activity in the range. Source bytes exclude derivatives. Provider usage contains returned metering only, never a billing estimate. Workspace owners/admins have the existing policy access to private workspace videos.

409.description: Narrow the range, or request a fresh report after an access change

post.summary: Queue a private CSV snapshot
post.description: At most 5000 rows, 10 MB and 25 seconds. Ten requests/user/hour, at most three pending. CSV values neutralize spreadsheet formulas. Access checked at request, build and download. Expires 24 hours after request.

CookieSession.name: better-auth.session_token
CookieSession.description: Better Auth browser session. HTTPS deployments use the __Secure-better-auth.session_token cookie name.

DeviceBearer.description: Token returned by /device/exchange; normally valid30 days.

ShareQueryToken.name: share
ShareQueryToken.description: Unlisted/password share access only. Password links also require per-video unlock cookie. Does not authenticate a commenter/reactor.

ShareHeaderToken.name: X-Share-Token
ShareHeaderToken.description: Alternative share token header; takes precedence over share query parameter.

ShareQuery.name: share
ShareQuery.description: Share token for unlisted/password access. X-Share-Token header takes precedence. Password visibility additionally requires its unlock cookie.

ShareHeader.name: X-Share-Token
ShareHeader.description: Alternative to the share query parameter.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Required and must equal BETTER_AUTH_URL for non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS requests without a Bearer header, except device start/exchange. Browser requests set this automatically.

RevisionQuery.name: revision
RevisionQuery.description: Editors may preview a ready revision of this video. Other viewers can access only the published revision.

VersionQuery.name: version
VersionQuery.description: Pin the expected resolved revision. Returns 409 REVISION_CHANGED when it no longer matches. Viewers can only pin current publication; editors may combine with revision preview. HLS playlists always propagate the resolved version to segment requests.

Range.name: Range
Range.description: One byte range only; suffix/open-ended ranges supported. Applies to binary media, not generated captions or HLS playlists.

Error400.description: Invalid identifier, request JSON, request fields, timestamps, or referenced source.

Error401.description: Authentication required, invalid bearer token, or public video access denied.

Error403.description: Insufficient permissions, untrusted request Origin, incorrect password, or invalid verifier.

Error409.description: State conflict, stale revision, incomplete upload, canceled recording, existing data conflict, or unavailable prerequisite.

Error410.description: Device login expired or already consumed.

Error413.description: Request body or upload part is too large.

Error428.description: AI note editing requires expectedRevisionId; capture the revision when the editor opens.

Error429.description: Rate limit exceeded; Retry-After is currently 60 seconds.

Error500.description: Server failure; diagnostic details are kept in server logs.

code.description: Optional machine code, for example PASSWORD_REQUIRED or ACCESS_DENIED. SPEECH_CONFIGURATION_UNAVAILABLE means no session was admitted with that choice. CAPTIONS_UNAVAILABLE denotes nonempty text without timestamps.

id.description: Better Auth user ID; not necessarily a UUID.

Workspace.description: role is included by /me, GET /workspaces/{id}, and creation. Creation also returns database field created_at; PATCH and invitation acceptance return only id/name.

mediaKind.description: Original recording kind. Edited revisions may stitch video and audio sources.

enhanceAudio.description: Whether initial processing applied voice enhancement. Recordings created before this option report false.

Video.description: favorite/watchLater are personal bookmarks for the current user. Media URLs carry the published version pin and supplied share token when applicable.

Clip.description: end must exceed start and not exceed source revision duration (+0.05 second tolerance). Sources must be editable and in the same workspace. Times are seconds in the selected source revision.

Blur.description: Times are seconds in edited output. end > start and end <= output duration. Normalized rectangle must fit: x+width <= 1 and y+height <= 1.

speaker.description: Optional anonymous label from the provider; labels are scoped to their transcription window, not person identities. Manual correction inputs currently discard speaker labels.

Word.description: end >= start; times must be ordered within their enclosing segment.

speaker.description: Optional anonymous label from the provider; labels are scoped to their transcription window, not person identities. Manual correction inputs currently discard speaker labels.

Segment.description: end >= start. Segment start times must be nondecreasing. End times may not exceed the recording admission limit or revision duration +1 second when duration is known.

version.description: Monotonic content version. Status-only updates do not change it.

userEdited.description: Manual corrections inherited or applied on this revision; automatic transcription cannot overwrite them.

timestamps.description: Every retained occurrence of this comment on the current revision. Replies retain their parent identity.

Reaction.description: reacted can be null for an anonymous viewer because the SQL comparison has no current user.

AIResult.description: Fields may be null before generation completes. userEdited lists fields preserved during regeneration. Results belong to revisionId. Each revision retains its own notes; republishing an older revision restores its matching notes.

Share.description: Only editors receive share settings in video detail. Saving replaces the token and invalidates prior password unlock cookies. URLs can be relative (detail) or absolute (mutation response).

VideoDetail.description: Transcript/comments/AI target published revision, falling back to initial revision before publication. Non-editors get an empty revisions array and null share settings.

maxUploadBytes.description: Recording admission byte ceiling. Default 32 GiB.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Recording admission duration. Default six hours.

Analytics.description: Aggregates only the current published revision. Views count play events; unique viewers use the signed-in user or anonymous viewer cookie. Completion rate is distinct completed sessions / distinct played sessions, clamped at one.

AISettings.description: No credential is returned. Vertex configured means project and location are present; it does not prove that Application Default Credentials are valid.

mediaKind.description: Source stream kind, checked against decoded media. Audio accepts AAC/MP4 or Opus/WebM.

enhanceAudio.description: Enhance voice in the published playback: 80 Hz high-pass, RNNoise denoising and volume leveling. The uploaded original is kept unchanged. Fixed when the recording is first admitted.

FinalizeInput.description: Manifest must be sorted and contiguous from index zero. Every nonfinal part is exactly 8388608 bytes. All bytes belong to ONE complete media file; do not concatenate separately encoded containers. Finalization queues processing and is idempotent for an identical manifest/MIME type. Caller duration is provisional; FFmpeg determines published duration.

RevisionInput.description: Edited duration must not exceed the current server admission limit (default 21600 seconds). thumbnailTime refers to edited output and cannot exceed edited duration. A supplied non-null expectedRevisionId detects stale editors; missing or null uses the revision current at request entry. Render publication is also fenced against subsequent publication changes.

source.description: Device uploads target the initial revision, are idempotent, and cannot overwrite manual corrections. Omit for manual edits.

TranscriptInput.description: Up to 8,000,000 request-body bytes. Manual edits target the current published revision or initial revision before publication. Device transcripts target the initial revision even after another revision is published; canceled/deleted recordings reject writes. Late speech does not delay media publication. Corrected transcripts cannot be overwritten by device retries. Text-only manual corrections use timing:none, text, and empty segments. Text-only results cannot produce captions or timed edits. Limits follow the target revision admission snapshot.

ShareInput.description: password is required every time visibility=password is saved. At least one email is required when visibility=shared. Each save rotates the token, replaces the recipient list, and invalidates previous password unlocks.

CommentInput.description: Body is trimmed. timestamp must fit the recording. revisionId defaults to published revision and must equal it. Reply parent must be a comment on the same video and revision.

EventInput.description: revisionId defaults to and must equal published revision. position cannot exceed duration on record +1 second. The submitted duration is required but the server stores the authoritative recording duration. Events deduplicate by video/revision/session/event/floor(position).

AIGenerateInput.description: Generation always queues work for the current published revision and preserves user-edited fields. regenerate is a compatibility hint; no separate generation path is selected. expectedRevisionId rejects a stale generation request.

AIPatch.description: At least one content field is required. Only fields supplied are marked user-edited. Chapter starts must fit the video. Send the revision captured when the editor opened as expectedRevisionId to reject stale edits.

AISettingsInput.description: Model is trimmed. Keys are encrypted and never echoed. Omit an API key to retain the stored credential only when the provider is unchanged. Enabled non-Vertex providers require a stored/new key. Vertex requires project/location and uses server Application Default Credentials; browser apiKey is not used for Vertex authentication.

maxUploadBytes.description: Recording admission byte ceiling. Default 32 GiB.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Recording admission duration. Default six hours.

TranscriptionSelection.description: External speech requires an explicitly selected, enabled, tested configuration and exact version allowed for the workspace. Device mode supports Parakeet only. Server derives the model from configuration; it never trusts the input model. No provider fallback. Missing selection defaults to self-hosted Parakeet. Legacy transcriptionMode remains supported; conflicting old/new fields are rejected.

SpeechConfigurationInput.description: Instance admin only. Supply expectedVersion for updates. A new configuration requires apiKey; omission retains an existing key. Every save increments version and invalidates connectivity verification. Keys are encrypted server-side and never returned. Enabling requires a nonempty workspace allowlist.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 with exact ordered headings for this immutable template version.

anyOf.description: Null when pricing is unavailable; numeric database values may serialize as decimal strings.

WatchInterval.description: wallStart/wallEnd are monotonic epoch milliseconds (performance.timeOrigin + performance.now()). Up to 30 seconds per interval; receipt no more than 90 seconds after wallStart, wallEnd at most 5 seconds ahead of server clock. Sequence starts at zero and increases; overlapping wall intervals are rejected. Media advance must fit elapsed time times playbackRate plus 350 ms tolerance. Owner playback is always preview. Playback telemetry is best effort, not tamper-proof evidence.

EngagementReport.description: Views count eligible sessions. Completion is >=90% unique coverage per session. Watch time is wall time capped by played media/rate, unioned across simultaneous tabs per viewer. Unique watched seconds sum unique coverage per viewer; repeated media includes repeated/simultaneous tabs. Known-viewer history only; anonymous viewers remain aggregated. Date filters select sessions by server receipt start time. Legacy point events are approximate and separate.

url.description: HTTPS only; no credentials, control characters or whitespace

MediaPresentation.description: Versioned render options. Source blurs run before canvas fitting; overlays and styled captions use the edited output timeline. Captions require every source to have a ready timed transcript and fence versions before publication. At most 30 overlays and 10000 burned caption segments. No crop removes source pixels.

commentEmail.description: Email when someone comments on your video or replies to your comment.

viewEmail.description: Email the first time each viewer plays your video; at most 20 view notifications per video per day.
